The source advertises 192 coordinates but prints 187, with no printed erasure marker at the inferred gap.

The model inserts five unknown coordinates before source index35. All 188 possible single contiguous five-coordinate-gap placements are scored against 92 directly witnessed C2 plaintext positions. Gap 35 alone has zero observed-coordinate mismatches.

cross_copy_alignment.geometry_selection: Use only 92 equal-position witnesses from uncorrected C2. Preserve both substitutions and all insertion/separator/ending differences outside this mask.

cross_copy_alignment.chronology_limit: Both printed a.m. receipts precede 13.40 on the same date; no date or time correction is inferred.

footer_pair_witness.assumption: Fixed published transposition ranks; no unknown square labels need be assigned.

earlier_repository_candidates.interpretation: The address, C2 warning and footer were already recognizable in unreviewed OCR screens. B2 had a five-coordinate length deficit. This edition corrects literal transcription, supplies an independently witnessed missing-group model and certificates, and does not claim first historical decipherment.
